CONTEXT & CHALLENGE

Standing Strong in Coastal Bangladesh

Satkhira district, situated on the vulnerable coastal edge of Southwestern Bangladesh adjacent to the Sundarbans, faces extreme climate vulnerability, seasonal salinity intrusion, and economic hardship.

Children in low-income coastal villages often face disrupted schooling due to extreme weather, poverty, and inadequate educational infrastructure. Dinghy Foundation works directly with local families to build resilient learning spaces and foster dignified community growth.

Know More →

Providing tuition support, learning materials, and warm learning environments for vulnerable coastal children.

WHO WE ARE

Dignified Progress for Satkhira's Children & Families

Our Mission

To empower low-income coastal communities in Bangladesh through inclusive, high-quality education, youth leadership, and holistic awareness programs that foster self-reliance and dignity.

Our Vision

A resilient, educated, and equitable coastal society where every child reaches their full potential regardless of socio-economic or environmental hardships.

WHAT WE DO

Integrated Programs for Sustainable Growth

Child Education

Sundarbans Learning Hubs & Scholarships

Establishing community-managed learning centers and distributing educational kits, uniforms, and books to underprivileged children across Satkhira.

15 Active Hubs Target: 1,500 students
View Details →
Health & Awareness

Clean Water & Hygiene Literacy

Educating children and mothers on water purification, menstrual hygiene, and disease prevention in salinity-affected coastal zones.

35 Workshops Conducted 5,000+ Participants
View Details →
Coastal Livelihood

Coastal Climate Preparedness & Youth Action

Training local youth volunteers in emergency disaster response, tree planting, and community safety during cyclone seasons.

250 Youth Volunteers 12 Coastal Villages
